messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to posing for a photo, following the action demonstrated in the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to posing for a photo, following the demonstration in the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character turns and poses, raising one arm to touch her hair and then crossing her arms in front of her chest.","camera":"A static medium shot from behind and slightly to the side, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"She wears a black off-the-shoulder dress with puffed sleeves, a studded bodice, and a floral pattern on the back.","hair_color":"Bright red.","hairstyle":"Hair is gathered into two small buns on top of the head with short bangs framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown from the back and side in a cobblestone street.","scene":"A European-style cobblestone street with brick and stone buildings, street lamps, and a Union Jack flag hanging on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character now turns away from the camera and performs a posing sequence: raising an arm to touch her hair, placing a hand on her hip, crossing her arms, and turning back toward the front. The same red-haired character, black dress, and cobblestone street remain.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to posing for a photo following the reference motion, while keeping identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression remained unchanged is hard to verify because the face is mostly turned away for much of the output.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing changed from a front-facing medium shot to a rear/side view, contrary to the instruction to keep the camera unchanged.
The dress's back design appears as a large floral pattern, which was not visible in the source front view and may be a newly generated detail.
